text:
maria: Quick monthly consolidation — looking at Feb 15 → Mar 20 incident cluster. I sliced incidents by root cause and recurrence; posting a short summary and proposed follow-ups. TL;DR: 3 buckets (deploy regressions, autoscaler misconfig, KV/cache evictions) cover ~68% of pages.

ajay: Nice — can you drop the counts?

maria: Sure. Raw counts (Feb 15–Mar 20):
```
deploy-regressions: 12
autoscaler/scale-down surprises: 8
kv/cache-evictions: 6
network blips (infra): 3
third-party rate-limit: 2
other: 4
TOTAL incidents reviewed: 35
```

sara: That matches what we saw in postmortems — most deploy regressions were bad canary rules + missing compatibility test.

maria: Agreed. Breakdown of deploy regressions: 7 bad canary config, 3 rollout tool flakiness, 2 model artifact mismatch.

oliver: For autoscaler ones, are these mostly scale-to-zero issues or aggressive scale-down during bursty traffic?

maria: Mostly aggressive scale-down (6/8). Short bursts + TTL-based worker termination. Two were unrelated OOMs.

jin: KV evictions — is this due to memory pressure or eviction policy changes?

maria: Memory pressure (4) from log-retention bump and 2 from a GC regression in the cache client.

tanya: Good summary. Proposed thematic fixes: 1) tighten canary pass criteria + add synthetic traffic checks; 2) autoscaler sim harness + make scale-down conservative for critical routes; 3) enforce KV memory budgets + alert on eviction rate spikes; 4) rollout retry circuit + better artifact validation.

ajay: Can we assign owners and timelines? I'd like actionable items with due dates before next month.

maria: Yep — draft action items below. Please ack and update if you want different owners.

Action items (owner — due):
1) Canary criteria update + synthetic traffic harness — owner: sara — due: 2026-04-09
2) Autoscaler simulation harness & conservative scale-down flag for critical routes — owner: oliver — due: 2026-04-16
3) KV eviction dashboard + eviction-rate alert (pager) — owner: jin — due: 2026-04-02
4) Rollout artifact integrity checks (hashing + size + schema) — owner: tanya — due: 2026-04-05
5) Postmortem follow-up tracker: correlate remediations with incident recurrence (quarterly report) — owner: maria — due: 2026-04-30

ajay: I can help on #2 (autoscaler sim) with a basic load-replay harness. cc @oliver

oliver: Thanks. I’ll pick up the conservative-scale-down flag and work with Ajay on the sim.

jin: Will do the dashboard. Quick ask: do we want eviction rate alert to page or just slack @eng-oncall first? Recommend slack first, then page if unresolved for 15m.

tanya: Artifact checks — I'll prototype a lightweight validator that runs as part of the deploy pipeline.

maria: Two procedural notes: 1) please add a single-line status update to the postmortem ticket when you start work (so ops-bot can synthesize), 2) set the ticket priority to P2 unless blockers discovered.

ops-bot: Reminder: link your PR to the postmortem ticket with the tag #incident-followup to enable automated tracking.

ajay: One more ask — can we get a small retro on recurring patterns in the next SRE sync? 10–15min. I think showing the cluster graph for the last 3 months will help prioritize.

maria: Good idea. I'll put a 15min slot on next Thu SRE sync and paste the cluster graph.

sara: ACK on owner assignments. I'll start the canary criteria doc and post a draft by 2026-03-30.

oliver: ACK on my items, ETA for initial PR 2026-04-09.

jin: Dashboard ETA 2026-04-01, will post link in this thread.

tanya: Prototype validator PR by 2026-04-04.

maria: Thanks all. I'll follow up next week with the SRE sync invite and the consolidated spreadsheet of incident clusters (will link here). If anyone needs to change owners/dates, reply in-thread. :thumbsup:

ajay: Thanks — this is great. Small nit: can we add a metric for 'time-to-remediation' in the quarterly report? That would show if follow-ups are actually reducing recurrence.

maria: Good call; adding TTRem as a column in the report.

sara: One last thing — add smoke tests for the KV client after major dependency bumps. Will include in canary doc.

ops-bot: Ticket check — the following postmortem tickets referenced: PM-3341, PM-3350, PM-3362. Ensure PRs include #incident-followup tag.

maria: Closing loop — will mark thread as 'action items assigned' once first status updates show up on tickets. Thanks everyone.

ajay: :thumbsup:
